system.description: Plants an illusion that the floor has violently tilted beneath 1 human-sized or smaller creature (+1 target per level after 1st). Targets failing a Save vs. Spells fall prone and lose 1 round standing up. Alternatively, the caster may impose a -1 save penalty per extra target sacrificed (e.g., at 3rd level: 3 targets, 2 targets at -1, or 1 target at -2).
